notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Sorry about the broken update yesterday which included a conflict with new PS4 stuff, this one will be good.

[b]Improvements[/b]
- Adds one security about DirectX violation with splashscreen so the game could still be loaded
- Adds ability to switch one keyboard configuration for an other player, for example if you want to play 4 players but with only 3 gamepads, it's now possible
-> in the remapping screen, press A on "Player 1" and switch left/right to change the player assignation
- Adds ability to change camera shaking intensity in the pause options
- Adds ability to deactivate gamepad rumble in the pause options
- Adds missing localized move list

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixes NPCs disappearing in levels 3 and 5 if player go back to spawn position
- Fixes AI not following player if he is not Player 1
- Fixes ability to use taser on dogs
- Fixes ability of female soldier to shoot out of screen
- Fixes wrong behaviours on end of tutorial level
- Fixes chainsaw range
- Fixes wrong position of Natasha & Boris when catched by Ivan
- Fixes Vlad wrong layer order after 4th boss death
- Fixes wrong skip icon displayed on cinematics
- Fixes stun applied on not grounded NPCs
- Fixes ability to TP on unvisible NPCs by using Orange Tundra
- Adds missing shadows on some NPCs on 7th boss scene
- Tweaks 1st boss dash punch range
- Lowers player AI minimum health before healing hisself during Nekro fight
- Fixes wrong UI display after keyboard remapped


PS : sorry for the delay, currently working hard on the PS4 port, should be able to work on new stuff soon.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixes an issue where the friendly fire was not registered correctly, which prevented "Peace" and "Broforce" achievement to be succeeded.

Thanks to the players who send me details by email in order to understand where the tricky issue was.

EDIT : "Broforce" seems still broken, we'll take a look at it

EDIT 2 : "Broforce" is working well, seems like the translation doesn't fit what player actually have to do to unlock it : it's the same than "God" achievement, but in coop where nobody has to take damage

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
- Adds a score penalty when all players are dead or when using "reload last checkpoint"
- Adds one security on score upload
- Adds body limitation to avoid game freeze after reaching high wave in survival mode
- Adds "sleep mode" on gamepad to avoid vibration if player uses a keyboard
- Improves player AI on some events and against some bosses

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixes punch holding system : release punch button while charging a focus will do a high punch instead of cancelling charge
- Fixes AI player stuck on camera border trying to punch ground
- Fixes game freeze when a new player joins during a conversation
- Fixes AI stuck on punch ground if holding a weapon
- Fixes AI stuck if activating a punch ground a dog which dies the same frame
- Fixes helicopter shoot detection on NPCs
- Fixes Ivan focus ground punch stuck in end of animation
- Fixes ability to hit a dead player lying on the floor
- Fixes "The One" achievement not being showed right after the event
- Fixes NPCs who spawned during the first penthouse boss conversation
- Fixes player ground punched not released if NPC explode
- Fixes prison riot NPC spawns
- Fixes ability to destroy talkie with an explosion
- Fixes wrong background light in tunnel phase
- Fixes train not coming in against level 4 boss
- Fixes music not launched during gimp crisis
- Fixes unability to punch ground the boss 5
- Fixes motorcycle ability to hit player while he is entering the last cinematic
- Fixes riot girl not throwing molotovs on cops
- Fixes riot girl moving in the cop wall if a NPC is on the left
- Fixes shielded cops walk on hardcore
- Fixes ability to use taser on front shielded cop
- Fixes wrong material on dead bodies during global smoke
- Fixes npc with long scope to shoot after boss death
- Fixes boss 6 machine sprites
- Fixes boss 6 end dialogs
- Fixes Katana holded in a wrong way
- Fixes a way to go through flesh wall
- Fixes timer not being paused during Nekro visions
- Fixes wrong time bonus score
- Removes player 1 becoming a bot when the gamepad is disconnected
- Fixes missing inputs on tips

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Improvements[/b]
- Updates Unity engine
- Improves player AI
- Adds ability to skip a crisis cinematic
- Adds 4:3 resolution support
- Improves 21:9 resolution support
- Forces keyboard to control player 1
- Adds player 2 keyboard controls
- Improves air throwing
- Adds missing shadows on some decors
- Adds 1366x768 resolution in options
- Sniper no longer follows player when sample is activated
- Tweaks difficulty

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixes "Press Start" freeze after the 4th part of level 5 if the gimp died
- Fixes music not reloaded after death in some levels (like level 5 boss)
- Fixes some background artifacts
- Fixes wrong behaviours when unplugging a controller
- Fixes some wrong detections on allies when friendly fire is on
- Fixes a way to go out of arena 8
- Fixes a way to do one injection with no effect
- Fixes Bloody Mary syringe effect
- Fixes motorcycle behaviours when last cinematic is launched
- Fixes some checkpoints misplacements
- Removes ability to avoid player vomiting by pressing dash button
- Fixes wrong camera effects durations when slow motion is activated
- Fixes a way to stuck shielded cops
- Fixes animation when hited by a taser on the floor
- Fixes conductor cinematic break if player hurt them before launch
- Fixes talkie audio
- Fixes wrong achievement icon
- Fixes wrong input text when remapping keyboard
- Fixes wrong cinematic text position in level 6

[b]Known issues[/b]
- XBox controller not recognized : there is an issue with Windows 10 that we wont be able to fix, some of you were able to active it simply by pressing the XBox button on the center of the gamepad, however please try to update your driver
- OSX version crash on startup : please try as explained here : http://steamcommunity.com/app/311690/discussions/1/371918937280839810/
- No sound on Linux version : please refer to this thread : http://steamcommunity.com/app/311690/discussions/1/371918937284111424/

PS : FLAC version has been added for the OST

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Improvements :[/b]
- Updates the controller plugin
- Adds a "Restore" field on the keyboard remapping screen
- Adds a move list screen (gamepad and english only) accessible by pressing Right on the remapping screen
- Adds the ability to remap inputs as arrows
- Removes the obligation of playing as Player 1
- Adds ability to hit jumping dogs with single punches
- Tweaks difficulty on some story levels and arenas

[b]Fixes :[/b]
- Fixes a crash when plugging/unplugging a gamepad on the menu
- Fixes "Don't play with knifes" achievement
- Fixes the way of unlocking "Broforce" and "Peace" achievements
- Fixes a NPC animation when doing a 2nd fatality when the 1st was not completed
- Fixes a player freeze when the injection is done while being flatten by the train
- Fixes a memory leak on the menu
- Fixes a non recognition of inputs on the menu if player hits Escape when a bot was added
- Fixes the button display refresh on the menu when remapping keys
- Fixes the player animation stuck on self injection
- Fixes prisoner ally being stuck if the cinematic is launched while he is dead
- Fixes the ability to go forward if the prisoner ally is dead
- Fixes a way to go trough the closed door next to Fixions concert
- Fixes the rail sound being looped after boss death
- Fixes riot girls behaviour before the first cop cinematic
- Fixes player AI behaviour in the first crisis of level 8
- Fixes music not being played after loading last checkpoint
- Fixes music pitch staying high when berserk stops
- Fixes menu display on a 21:9 screen resolution
- Changes 2160p resolution which was set as 2610 height

[b]Known issues, need log files and more time to be fixed :[/b]
- Game crashes randomly when playing ('Attempt to access invalid address.')
- Game crashes on startup ('Fallback handler could not load library [...] xinput1_4.dll')
- Game freezes on "Press Start" loading screen (we need a log file from someone who has this problem)

[b]Fixes :[/b]

- Fixes "Don't play with knifes" achievement
